newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends easier against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends easier against dollar.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee ended weaker at 57.48 to the dollar on Monday, dealers said.

"In the morning business started at 57.40 rupees," said a foreign bank dealer. "Speculators pushed up the dollar to 57.55, then sellers came in to the market and it came down to 57.48. There were very few import bills."
The rupee had opened at its previous closing level of 57.40.
The Central Bank fixed buying and selling prices at 56.8829 and 58.0321.
Overnight call money rates closed at 13 percent after rising to 15 percent.
